name: Lee Saegyeol
source:
Chelsea is a beautiful woman with short stature and blue hair. She has large brown eyes and fair skin. Often, Chelsea wears things in pastel colours, especially blue, but she occasionally wears brighter clothing.

From [url=https://maybeinteractive.fandom.com/wiki/Chelsea_Flint] Maybe: Interactive Fandom WIki
